meta.source: Generated from the Workbench tokens.json (W3C DTCG 2025.10) by ds_build.py. Edit that file and regenerate; names match theme.slint and tokens.css one to one.

tokens.name: jidr-color-surface-base
tokens.usage: Window ground and main content area.

tokens.name: jidr-color-surface-chrome
tokens.usage: Title bar, tab strip, sidebar, device toolbar.

tokens.name: jidr-color-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, device rows on hover-less lists, inspector panel.

tokens.name: jidr-color-surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: device stage (letterbox), map frame, code blocks, progress tracks.

tokens.name: jidr-color-surface-control
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, inputs, segmented control track.

tokens.name: jidr-color-surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected row in the sidebar or device list.

tokens.name: jidr-color-surface-device-bezel
tokens.usage: The bezel drawn around the Android screen. Dark in both themes, like hardware. Contrast dark/light: surface-sunken 1.19/14.09.

tokens.name: jidr-color-text-primary
tokens.usage: Body text, names, values. Contrast dark/light: surface-base 15.68/17.22; surface-chrome 14.93/16.02; surface-raised 14.05/18.29; surface-overlay 12.48/18.29; surface-control 12.82/16.62; surface-selected 11.99/15.6; surface-sunken 16.12/15.44; selection 8.23/12.68; accent-container 11.64/15.18; logcat-fatal-row 13.38/15.56.

tokens.name: jidr-color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Metadata, field labels, inactive tabs. Contrast dark/light: surface-base 7.49/5.88; surface-chrome 7.13/5.48; surface-raised 6.71/6.25; surface-overlay 5.96/6.25; surface-control 6.12/5.68; surface-selected 5.73/5.33; surface-sunken 7.7/5.28.

tokens.name: jidr-color-text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Hints, placeholder text, timestamps. Still 4.5:1 on every surface. Contrast dark/light: surface-base 6.47/5.13; surface-chrome 6.16/4.77; surface-raised 5.8/5.45; surface-overlay 5.15/5.45; surface-control 5.29/4.95; surface-selected 4.95/4.65.

tokens.name: jidr-color-text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills. Contrast dark/light: accent-fill 4.61/5.9; accent-hover 5.2/7.02; accent-pressed 6.41/8.36; negative-fill 5.08/6.25; negative-fill-hover 6.07/7.5.

tokens.name: jidr-color-text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels. Exempt from 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3), always paired with a disabled cursor and no hover.

tokens.name: jidr-color-text-code
tokens.usage: Serials, package names, CLI snippets inside code wells. Contrast dark/light: surface-sunken 11.65/9.25.

tokens.name: jidr-color-border-default
tokens.usage: Card and panel outlines, window splits.

tokens.name: jidr-color-border-strong
tokens.usage: Outlines of inputs, checkboxes, radios: 3:1 against raised and control fills. Contrast dark/light: surface-raised 3.77/3.67; surface-base 4.21/3.45; surface-control 3.44/3.33.

tokens.name: jidr-color-accent-fill
tokens.usage: The one primary action per surface; selected segment; slider fill. Contrast dark/light: surface-raised 3.71/5.9.

tokens.name: jidr-color-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Accent fill on hover (darker in both themes so on-accent keeps 4.5:1).

tokens.name: jidr-color-accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text and icons on surfaces (links, active tab marker). Contrast dark/light: surface-base 7.65/5.55; surface-raised 6.86/5.9; surface-overlay 6.09/5.9.

tokens.name: jidr-color-accent-container
tokens.usage: Tinted accent background (selected segment in a card, drop-zone hover).

tokens.name: jidr-color-positive
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on surfaces. Contrast dark/light: surface-base 10.11/4.85; surface-raised 9.06/5.15; surface-chrome 9.63/4.51.

tokens.name: jidr-color-negative
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on surfaces; destructive button fill uses negative-fill. Contrast dark/light: surface-base 6.73/5.29; surface-raised 6.03/5.63; surface-chrome 6.41/4.93.

tokens.name: jidr-color-warning
tokens.usage: Caution text and icons on surfaces. Contrast dark/light: surface-base 10.71/5.39; surface-raised 9.6/5.73; surface-chrome 10.2/5.02.

tokens.name: jidr-color-info
tokens.usage: In-progress and informational text and icons. Contrast dark/light: surface-base 7.65/5.55; surface-raised 6.86/5.9; surface-chrome 7.29/5.17.

tokens.name: jidr-color-root
tokens.usage: Root identity colour: text and icons for root states on surfaces. Contrast dark/light: surface-base 7.0/5.46; surface-raised 6.27/5.8; surface-chrome 6.66/5.08.

tokens.name: jidr-color-focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2 px focus ring, 2 px offset, on every focusable element. Contrast dark/light: surface-base 7.65/5.55; surface-raised 6.86/5.9; surface-chrome 7.29/5.17; surface-control 6.26/5.36.

tokens.name: jidr-color-selection
tokens.usage: Text selection and logcat row selection.

tokens.name: jidr-logcat-fatal-row
tokens.usage: Background of F rows, so fatal lines stand out without colour on the text alone.

tokens.name: jidr-logcat-fatal
tokens.usage: F (also bold, on fatal-row). Contrast dark/light: logcat-background 10.1/7.34; logcat-fatal-row 8.39/6.24.

tokens.name: jidr-logcat-meta
tokens.usage: Timestamp and pid columns. Contrast dark/light: logcat-background 6.66/5.45.

groups.name: App
groups.note: Geist for UI, Geist Mono for code and live numbers. macOS-sized: body is 13 px.

styles.name: type-hero
styles.usage: The one big thing a surface is for: device name in its detail view, the root result.

styles.name: type-display
styles.usage: First-run and empty-state titles.

styles.name: type-headline
styles.usage: Page title in the content area (Devices, Settings).

styles.name: type-title
styles.usage: Card titles, sheet sections, widget headers.

styles.name: type-body
styles.sample: Reboots the device to finish root setup (about 40 s).
styles.usage: Default UI text (macOS 13 pt).

styles.name: type-label
styles.usage: Buttons, field labels, pills, tabs.

styles.name: type-caption
styles.usage: Secondary metadata under a name.

styles.name: type-code
styles.usage: Serials, ports, package names, CLI: emulator-5556, com.example.shop. Always LTR, even in RTL.

styles.name: type-metric
styles.usage: Live numbers: 64%, 62% boot, 1.4 / 2.1 GB, 32.8954, 13.1802. Tabular figures (Geist Mono).

styles.name: type-metric-lg
styles.usage: Large live readout in a widget (battery level, speed). Tabular figures (Geist Mono).

groups.name: Arabic (RTL)
groups.note: Noto Kufi Arabic. Line heights run 1.6–1.75× the size against Latin's 1.2–1.4×; text sizes go up 1 px, display sizes down.

styles.name: type-hero-ar
styles.usage: Arabic hero. No letter-spacing; taller line height than Latin.

styles.name: type-display-ar
styles.usage: Arabic display. No letter-spacing; taller line height than Latin.

styles.name: type-headline-ar
styles.usage: Arabic headline. No letter-spacing; taller line height than Latin.

styles.name: type-title-ar
styles.usage: Arabic title. No letter-spacing; taller line height than Latin.

styles.name: type-body-ar
styles.sample: يُعيد تشغيل الجهاز لإكمال إعداد الجذر (نحو 40 ث).
styles.usage: Arabic body. No letter-spacing; taller line height than Latin.

styles.name: type-label-ar
styles.usage: Arabic label. No letter-spacing; taller line height than Latin.

styles.name: type-caption-ar
styles.usage: Arabic caption. No letter-spacing; taller line height than Latin.

groups.name: Landing page
groups.note: Larger roles for jidr.ly. The hero steps to 48/52 at 768 and 40/44 at 390.

styles.name: type-web-hero
styles.sample: Android on your Mac. Rooted in a minute.
styles.usage: Landing headline at ≥1280 px. Steps to 48/52 at 768 and 40/44 at 390.

styles.name: type-web-hero-sm
styles.usage: Landing headline at 390 px.

styles.name: type-web-display
styles.sample: Genymotion’s paid features, free in Jidr
styles.usage: Section headlines on the landing page.

styles.name: type-web-headline
styles.usage: Feature titles, card headings.

styles.name: type-web-lede
styles.sample: Jidr creates and runs virtual Android phones and tablets on Apple Silicon.
styles.usage: Hero subhead.

styles.name: type-web-body
styles.sample: Pick Full root and Magisk is set up and verified for you.
styles.usage: Landing running text.

styles.name: type-web-code
styles.usage: CLI and MCP samples.

shadow.note: Dark: elevation is a lighter surface tint plus border, shadow transparent. Light: one shadow per level (Slint draws one drop shadow per element).

tokens.name: jidr-elevation-0-shadow
tokens.usage: Ground. Dark: transparent shadow, elevation is the surface tint.

tokens.name: jidr-elevation-1-shadow
tokens.usage: Cards, device rows. Dark: transparent shadow, elevation is the surface tint.

tokens.name: jidr-elevation-2-shadow
tokens.usage: Popover, menu, tooltip, command palette. Dark: transparent shadow, elevation is the surface tint.

tokens.name: jidr-elevation-3-shadow
tokens.usage: Sheet, dialog, toast. Dark: transparent shadow, elevation is the surface tint.

spacing.note: 4 px base. Components use sm/md/lg; sections xl and up.

radius.note: Pills for state, 8 for controls, 12 for cards, 14 for sheets.

tokens.name: jidr-radius-xs
tokens.usage: kbd, beta tag, checkbox, logcat level chip.

tokens.name: jidr-radius-sm
tokens.usage: Segment inside a segmented control, small icon buttons.

tokens.name: jidr-radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows, toolbar buttons.

tokens.name: jidr-radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, menus, job rows, snapshot cards.

tokens.name: jidr-radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, the landing-page window mock.

border.note: Hairline everywhere; 1.5 px only on outlined root badges; focus ring 2 px with a 2 px offset.

tokens.name: jidr-border-width-emphasis
tokens.usage: Outline root badges, failed badge, unverified states.

tokens.name: jidr-border-focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between element and focus ring.

size.note: Icon sizes 14/16/20 with a 1.75 stroke; control heights 24/30/44.

tokens.name: jidr-icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Lucide stroke width at every size.

tokens.name: jidr-control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Compact segmented control, inline row actions.

frame.note: Our neutral device bezel per device class, in window points. No notch, camera, buttons or brand shape.

tokens.name: jidr-frame-stage-padding
tokens.usage: Minimum gap between bezel and window edge; the rest is letterbox in surface.sunken.

density.note: Device list: default two-line rows, compact one-line rows.

layout.note: App window minimums and panel widths; landing-page breakpoints.

tokens.name: jidr-window-device-toolbar-width
tokens.usage: Vertical toolbar of 32 px icon buttons.

tokens.name: jidr-window-device-min-screen-height
tokens.usage: Below this the screen stops shrinking; the window cannot get smaller.

duration.note: Durations and motion distances. Under Reduce Motion the motion-* values switch to their reduced values (bundle.css).

tokens.name: jidr-motion-hover-duration
tokens.usage: Colour change on hover/press. Colour is not movement, so it stays under Reduce Motion.

tokens.name: jidr-motion-popover-duration
tokens.usage: Fade + 4 px rise. Reduced: fade only.

tokens.name: jidr-motion-popover-distance
tokens.usage: Fade + 4 px rise. Reduced: fade only.

tokens.name: jidr-motion-sheet-duration
tokens.usage: Slides down from the title bar 12 px + fade, scrim fades. Reduced: crossfade only.

tokens.name: jidr-motion-sheet-distance
tokens.usage: Slides down from the title bar 12 px + fade, scrim fades. Reduced: crossfade only.

tokens.name: jidr-motion-panel-duration
tokens.usage: Widget panel / inspector width change. Reduced: instant.

tokens.name: jidr-motion-status-duration
tokens.usage: Pill colour + label crossfade when a status changes. Reduced: instant swap.

tokens.name: jidr-motion-progress-duration
tokens.usage: Progress bar width follows bytes done. Reduced: width jumps; numbers still update.

tokens.name: jidr-motion-skeleton-duration
tokens.usage: Shimmer sweep. Reduced: static sunken fill.

tokens.name: jidr-motion-spinner-duration
tokens.usage: loader-circle rotation. Reduced: static icon; the label and % carry the state.

tokens.name: jidr-easing-enter
tokens.usage: Things arriving: sheet, popover, panel open.

tokens.name: jidr-motion-hover-easing
tokens.usage: Colour change on hover/press. Colour is not movement, so it stays under Reduce Motion.

tokens.name: jidr-motion-popover-easing
tokens.usage: Fade + 4 px rise. Reduced: fade only.

tokens.name: jidr-motion-sheet-easing
tokens.usage: Slides down from the title bar 12 px + fade, scrim fades. Reduced: crossfade only.

tokens.name: jidr-motion-panel-easing
tokens.usage: Widget panel / inspector width change. Reduced: instant.

tokens.name: jidr-motion-status-easing
tokens.usage: Pill colour + label crossfade when a status changes. Reduced: instant swap.

tokens.name: jidr-motion-progress-easing
tokens.usage: Progress bar width follows bytes done. Reduced: width jumps; numbers still update.

tokens.name: jidr-motion-skeleton-easing
tokens.usage: Shimmer sweep. Reduced: static sunken fill.

tokens.name: jidr-motion-spinner-easing
tokens.usage: loader-circle rotation. Reduced: static icon; the label and % carry the state.
